about: WoW Forever's release phases, in release order. The client already carries content the game has not opened yet; what a phase lists (and everything only it gives: loot, quests, recipes) shows as Later instead of missing until the phase opens. opens: the date it opens (YYYY-MM-DD), or null while Blizzard has not announced one. maps: instances by English name or map id. npcs, objects, quests, items, spells: ids (npcs also by English name). See docs/PHASES.md.

phases.name: First raids
phases.source: Blizzard's raid preview: Barrow Deeps, Hyjal Summit and Onyxia's Lair open five weeks after launch. Map 3002: a raid the client keeps encrypted (no Map row, two raid encounters), so one of the two new raids

phases.name: Later dungeons
phases.source: In the client but not among the 9 new launch dungeons; Blizzard plans two more dungeons per 2027 update

phases.name: Later raids
phases.source: In the client, no date announced. Quests: the Thunderfury (Rise, Thunderfury!) and Atiesh chains, taken and handed in outside the raids their pieces drop in

phases.name: Not out yet
phases.source: Spells in the client that nothing teaches on live WoW Forever: Wowhead's Forever pages list no trainer, quest, item, talent or perk for them, and no client spell teaches them (2026-11-18): Teleport: Dalaran, Lacerate rank 4, Voice of Truth, Improved Seal of Fury. Mounts nobody can get on live WoW Forever (2026-11-18): devilsaurs, druid moose, warden sabers and the Caravan Kodo (their items still encrypted in the client, not on Wowhead), and Cerulean Prideclaw, Crimson Rooster, Dark and Green Skeletal Horse, Regal and Swift Regal Galestrider, Spectral Wolf Pack, Verdant Sea Turtle, Veteran Adventurer's Loyal Companion and Venomhide Ravasaur (on Wowhead's Forever pages with no drop, vendor, quest or other source)
